title: DINEOF-HPC: a high-performance Python/Numba implementation of DINEOF with space-time Barnes residual refinement (source code)
description: Source code of DINEOF-HPC (dineof_hpc), a Python/Numba implementation of Data Interpolating Empirical Orthogonal Functions (DINEOF) for large satellite ocean-colour datasets, with cross-validation on isolated points, optimal-interpolation error estimates and space-time Barnes residual refinement. Derived from pyDINEOF (Coqué, RBINS); reference implementation: DINEOF of the GHER group.
